objective: Test a natural conversational echo with two target notions in one minute, using two voices and different concrete contexts rather than literal translation.

target_words.fr: regretter / ressentir le manque avec nostalgie

common.model_preference: v6-mini prototype; V6 full for final pronunciation validation when available

variants.treatment: Two-person conversational echo: each language reuses the target idea in a different concrete situation

semantic_links.dejar atrás: The Spanish speaker leaves the city behind while departing; the French speaker reveals what they left behind when they left.
semantic_links.añorar: The Spanish speaker misses late-night memories; the French speaker misses rushed mornings.

human_lyrics_approval.note: Vincent reviewed D1/D2/D3, approved all as promising, then explicitly chose D1 to proceed.
